feats.title: Blessing of Corellon
feats.description: After an Elven Accuracy reroll hits, choose an ally within 5 squares; that ally may spend a healing surge.

feats.title: Bow Caster
feats.description: Bows count as implements for your artificer powers and your artificer paragon path powers.

feats.title: Brutal Accuracy
feats.description: An Elven Accuracy reroll that hits your quarry deals an additional 1d6 + Wisdom damage.

feats.title: Elven Beast Mastery
feats.description: Your beast companion ignores difficult terrain during shifts. Elven Accuracy can reroll either your attack or your beast companion's attack.

feats.title: Elven Guardian
feats.description: While in a guardian form, gain a +2 feat bonus to a weapon attack roll rerolled with Elven Accuracy.

feats.title: Fey Fate
feats.description: If an Elven Accuracy reroll hits your Oath of Enmity target, gain +2 to damage rolls against it through the end of your next turn. This becomes +4 at level 11 and +6 at level 21.

feats.title: Guiding Step
feats.description: Allies shifting because of your powers ignore difficult terrain for those shifts.

feats.title: Leading Fire
feats.description: After your bow attack hits, allies within 10 squares who can see and hear you gain +1 to ranged attack rolls against that enemy through the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Light-Footed Warrior
feats.description: Movement granted by your fighter attack powers ignores difficult terrain.

feats.title: Otherworldly Accuracy
feats.description: If Elven Accuracy rerolls a shaman spirit attack and it hits, allies adjacent to your spirit companion gain a +2 power bonus to attacks against that enemy through the start of your next turn.

feats.title: Roar of the Ancestors
feats.description: A hit with a barbarian fear attack power lets you push the enemy 1 square, in addition to the attack's other effects.

feats.title: Sneaky Accuracy
feats.description: When Elven Accuracy rerolls an attack against an enemy granting you combat advantage, a second miss leaves Elven Accuracy unexpended.

feats.title: Sylvan Fury
feats.description: Each use of Nature's Wrath lets you shift 1 square to exchange spaces with an adjacent enemy you have marked.

feats.title: Treetop Sniper
feats.description: Any bow can deliver your Sneak Attack and can be used for rogue powers whose weapon requirement is a crossbow.

feats.title: Valenar Weapon Warding
feats.description: Swordmage Warding grants +2 AC when you wield a falchion or double scimitar.

feats.title: Wild Grasp
feats.description: Warden's Grasp may pull its target 3 squares in place of its slide. A giant or goblin affected this way is also slowed through the end of its next turn.

feats.title: Wild Wrath
feats.requirements: elven accuracy power, invoker, Covenant of Wrath
feats.description: Targets hit by an Elven Accuracy reroll of an invoker encounter or daily attack power take 4 additional damage.

feats.title: Word of the Ancestors
feats.description: Inspiring Word restores additional hit points equal to your Intelligence.
